reset.body: You will use it to sign in from now on.

callback.confirmedBody: Sign in with your email and password.

callback.unknownBody: If it was to confirm your email, sign in with your password: if it still needs confirming, you can ask for another link. If it was to change your password, ask for another one.
callback.signedInBody: You are already signed in on this phone.

errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.

synced.title: All up to date
synced.body: Your changes are saved in the cloud.

syncedDrafts.title: Up to date, with drafts to review
syncedDrafts.body: Everything else is saved in the cloud. Your drafts are only on this phone until you decide.

pending.title: Changes to upload
pending.body: They upload on their own as soon as they can. You don't need to do anything.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: You can keep using the app. Changes upload when the internet is back.

error.title: Something needs your attention
error.body: Some data could not be synced. The details are below.

syncing.title: Syncing…
syncing.body: We are uploading and downloading changes.

sync.failed_one: {{count}} change the server did not accept
sync.failed_other: {{count}} changes the server did not accept
sync.failedHint: Your data is still on this phone; nothing was lost. Tap Retry to send it again.
sync.conflictsHint: Two people changed the same thing. Your version was saved as a draft so you can decide.
sync.held_one: {{count}} group with data that could not be saved
sync.held_other: {{count}} groups with data that could not be saved
sync.heldHint: Data arrived from the cloud that could not be saved here. The rest of the app keeps working. Retry tries again.

error.offline: There is no connection to the server.
error.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
error.auth: Your session is no longer valid. Sign out and sign in again.
error.protocol: The server did not understand the last upload.

unsynced.intro: This isn't in the cloud yet:

notice.conflict: “{{label}}” was changed on another device. Your version was saved as a draft.
notice.serverDeleted: “{{label}}” was deleted on another device. Your version was saved as a draft.
notice.deletionRejected: “{{label}}” wasn't deleted: it was changed on another device. Your deletion was saved as a draft.
notice.groupCurrencyChanged: “{{label}}” wasn't saved: the group's currency changed. It was saved as a draft.
notice.currencyLocked: The currency of “{{label}}” wasn't changed: it already has entries. It was saved as a draft.
notice.many_one: {{count}} of your changes wasn't applied. It was saved as a draft.
notice.many_other: {{count}} of your changes weren't applied. They were saved as drafts.
notice.memberLinked: "{{label}}" wasn't removed: they have an account in the group. Remove their access first. It was kept as a draft.
notice.quotaGroups: "{{label}}" wasn't saved: you reached the maximum number of groups. It was kept as a draft.
notice.quotaMembers: "{{label}}" wasn't saved: the group reached its maximum number of members. It was kept as a draft.
notice.quotaCategories: "{{label}}" wasn't saved: the group reached its maximum number of categories. It was kept as a draft.
notice.quotaMovements: "{{label}}" wasn't saved: the group reached its maximum number of entries. It was kept as a draft.

review.title: Changes to review
review.intro: Someone else changed the same thing before you. What you see in the app is the current version; yours is saved here and isn't lost until you decide.

reason.conflict: It was changed on another device.
reason.serverDeleted: It was deleted on another device.
reason.deletionRejected: Your deletion wasn't applied: it was changed on another device.
reason.groupCurrencyChanged: It wasn't saved: the group's currency changed.
reason.currencyLocked: The currency wasn't changed: the group already has entries.
reason.memberLinked: Not removed: that person has an account in the group.
reason.quotaGroups: Not saved: you reached the maximum number of groups.
reason.quotaMembers: Not saved: the group reached its maximum number of members.
reason.quotaCategories: Not saved: the group reached its maximum number of categories.
reason.quotaMovements: Not saved: the group reached its maximum number of entries.

review.noDiff: Your change wasn't applied and there is nothing different left to show.
review.deletionHint: You wanted to delete it, but someone changed it. You can delete it now or keep it as it is.
review.deletionGone: It no longer exists, so there is nothing to delete.

action.discardConfirm: Discard your version? What you see now doesn't change.

review.memberLinkedHint: To remove them from the group, remove their access first from the group settings.

sync.lost_one: {{count}} change won't be uploaded: you no longer have access
sync.lost_other: {{count}} changes won't be uploaded: you no longer have access
sync.lostHint: They stay on this phone, but the server no longer lets you change that group. If you rejoin with an invitation link, they are uploaded.

signOutSheet.title: Sign out
signOutSheet.keepHint: Your data stays encrypted on this phone for when you sign in again.
signOutSheet.wipe: Sign out and delete the data on this phone
signOutSheet.wipeHint: To leave the phone without your data, for example if it is not yours.
signOutSheet.confirmTitle: Delete the data on this phone?
signOutSheet.confirmBody: Your groups and entries are in the cloud: you get them back when you sign in again. They are only deleted from this phone.
signOutSheet.unsyncedBody: If you delete them from this phone now, they are lost for good.

deleteScreen.title: Delete your account
deleteScreen.itemPhone: The data of this account on this phone.
deleteScreen.itemGroups: Groups where no other person with an account remains. In shared groups, your name stays without an account and the group continues for everyone else, with your entries.
deleteScreen.emailMismatch: It does not match the email of this account.
deleteScreen.unsyncedBody: If you delete your account now, they are lost. If you upload them first, your changes in shared groups are kept for everyone else.

notices.accountDeletedDataKept: Your account was deleted, but the data on this phone could not be deleted. It stays encrypted; uninstalling the app also deletes it.
notices.dataDeleted: You signed out and the data on this phone was deleted.
notices.dataDeleteFailed: You signed out, but the data on this phone could not be deleted. It stays encrypted; uninstalling the app also deletes it.
